summary: Risk governance and controls professional with ~7 years of experience, targeting RBC's Director, Operational Risk Governance (Global Security) role. Model governance committee member at Moody's Analytics holding delegated sign-off on analytics delivered to institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement. Contributes to control framework documentation, benchmarking, and escalation standards within a formal governance framework; coordinates cross-functional regulatory transformation programs and stakeholder management across risk, product, and client functions; quantifies exposures through scenario and stress analysis. CFA charterholder with dual MSc degrees and applied familiarity with OSFI E-23 model-risk expectations and Basel Committee-aligned IRRBB standards.
core_skills: Risk Governance & Control Framework Contribution (Documentation, Benchmarking, Methodology Review)
Model Risk Management (OSFI E-23 / SR 11-7 aligned)
Cross-Functional Program Delivery (Influence Without Direct Authority)

sections.heading: Governance Execution & Independent Oversight
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for analytics delivered to institutional clients.

Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Operates within a formal model governance framework, validating assumptions and economic defensibility against documentation standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 model risk expectations.

sections.heading: Risk Assessment, Scenario Analysis & Monitoring
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, giving senior stakeholders forward-looking exposure visibility.

Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity and balance-sheet exposure analytics (T+1 through multi-year), enabling funding-related risk exposures to be quantified, monitored, and escalated across horizons.
Oversees quantification of interest-rate and balance-sheet exposures under parallel and non-parallel shock scenarios, an approach analogous to Basel Committee IRRBB supervisory frameworks.

sections.heading: Process Control Design, Automation & Audit Readiness
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, shadow-running two cycles before cutover to satisfy governance audit requirements.

Built agentic AI workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Escalation, Remediation & Stakeholder Communication
bullets: Acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, holding release of outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and coordinating remediation with product owners and clients' Heads of Risk.

Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives as part of ongoing stakeholder management with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms, acting as technical liaison between client stakeholders and product owners.
Contributed to the migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation programs for Canadian and international insurers, translating regulatory requirements into system implementation and financial reporting frameworks.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions, advising actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on standards adoption.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and project-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials across enterprise-wide programs, without formal authority over those teams.
Quantified funding-ratio, duration-mismatch, and long-horizon balance-sheet risk exposures through ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed risk decomposition and attribution (contribution-to-risk, risk budgeting) alongside VaR and CVaR optimization on Ortec's GLASS platform to prioritize exposures and test the robustness of recommendations.
Designed stochastic risk-management frameworks tailored to specific client mandates.
Presented study findings and risk recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
